The '''hologlobe''' was a decorative item and a type of [[holodiorama]] in form of a sphere depicting a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a specific event. [[Sacking of Coruscant]] Hologlobes were popular among the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref>{{TORcite|Galactic Starfighter}}</ref>
